ownership_rule: customer discovery belongs only to the customer entry surface
why_it_exists: start store and category intent for a DSH order
notes: no clean basis for control-panel or partner duplication

ownership_rule: checkout gating belongs only to the customer entry surface
why_it_exists: validate cart and checkout before order submission
notes: finance truth remains outside DSH surface ownership

ownership_rule: order submission is a customer action even when downstream work follows
why_it_exists: create a pending DSH order for downstream handling
notes: partner handling happens through dsh_partner_order_handling rather than submit duplication

ownership_rule: customer tracking stays on the customer surface while other actors use their own operation families
why_it_exists: reflect order lifecycle visibility back to the customer
notes: mirror visibility elsewhere is not tracking ownership

ownership_rule: chat endpoints live on the participating user surfaces only
why_it_exists: allow active order communication among customer partner and captain
notes: control-panel is excluded unless a later escalation family is explicitly locked

ownership_rule: partner order work belongs to the partner execution surface
why_it_exists: prepare handle and hand off store-side order work
notes: internal oversight remains separate from partner action ownership

ownership_rule: partner store maintenance belongs to the partner workspace
why_it_exists: maintain partner readiness inventory hours zones and service modes
notes: donor MCPW mirroring is rejected for the clean target model

ownership_rule: captain offer handling belongs to the captain execution surface
why_it_exists: accept reject and lock the job into captain execution
notes: ops visibility does not create a second ownership surface

ownership_rule: delivery execution belongs to the captain execution surface
why_it_exists: advance the accepted job through active delivery work
notes: customer visibility is covered through dsh_customer_order_tracking

ownership_rule: proof capture lives with captain execution while customer verification may be exposed when needed
why_it_exists: record or verify proof at the end of delivery
notes: customer-side verification stays optional until screen lock proves it is always required

ownership_rule: field activation work belongs only to the field support surface
why_it_exists: perform activation geo pin and visit support tasks when that path is enabled
notes: service-level field usage remains optional even though the family itself is field-owned

ownership_rule: proxy flow is a true dual-surface family with customer initiation and internal approval or intervention
why_it_exists: create and govern proxy requests across customer and internal ops contexts
notes: this is the clearest evidence-backed clean dual-surface family

ownership_rule: internal governance belongs only to the internal operations surface
why_it_exists: run peak mode exception handling and internal operational controls
notes: effects may reach other surfaces without moving operation ownership out of control-panel
